changelog: New voice command "copy last paragraph" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ কপি করো" in Bengali) and the paragraph right before the cursor is copied to the clipboard in one step, so you can paste it anywhere without the two-step "select last paragraph" + "copy". It is the one-segment version of v14.8's select. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 52 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
